result.brief: 提出两阶段训练管线 LongTake：在真实长视频上做长时程教师强制，为自回归视频扩散提供长程监督，并作为 DMD 分布匹配蒸馏的直接初始化；Hybrid DMD 复用教师对自回归 rollout 后段继续监督，在 30s/60s 长时程生成上取得动态度与美学质量的帕累托前沿。
result.reason: Long-horizon autoregressive video diffusion with long-horizon teacher forcing and DMD distillation; explicitly targets world models and long-take video generation, sustaining dynamics over 30–60s rollouts.
